# for

Use a Lua for-clause with DCode colon-and-indentation syntax.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `block.for` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Blocks |
| Family | Iteration |
| Monaco kind | `block` |
| Format | `for <Lua for-clause>:` |
| Valid contexts | `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `for index = 1, 10:<br>    -- body<br>` |

## Transformation

for <clause> do ... end

## Example

```lua

```
